ImageDescription.value:
Panorama over Tromsø from Fjellheisen

• In the foreground: Tromsdalen district with the Arctic Cathedral (right in front of the bridge) • In the center of the picture: The entire island of Tromsøya with the city center of Tromsø, the harbor and Tromsø bridge, behind it Tromsø airport with Sandnessund bridge • Behind: Grindøysund with the islands of Grindøya and Håkøya

• In the background: Kvaløya and on the right Ringvassøya

ImageDescription.value:
Day Five in Norway ... back on dry land, in Tromsø.

After breakfast, we walked across the Tromsø bridge to the mainland. It had snowed during the night, and it snowed off and on during the morning.

The Arctic Cathedral, formally known as Tromsdalen Church or Tromsøysund Church, was closed until 14:00. So we walked up the hill to the chair lift to see the view from the top.

Credit.value: View from the Arctic Cathedral

Artist.value: Leonora (Ellie) Enking from East Preston, United Kingdom
